title: Commutative-square exchange agrees with cohomology pullback on etale charts
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$, $f':X'\to Y'$, $g:Y'\to Y$, and $g':X'\to X$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme] with $fg'=gf'$. No cartesianness is assumed. Let $F$ be an abelian sheaf on $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] and $q\geq0$. On the bounded below derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], use exact inverse images [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image], derived direct images [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], and the adjunctions $f^{-1}\dashv Rf_*$, $f'^{-1}\dashv Rf'_*$ [prop-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image-adjunction]. Let $E^q:g^{-1}R^qf_*F\to R^qf'_*g'^{-1}F$ be degree-$q$ cohomology of the commutative-square derived exchange [def-kun-commutative-derived-exchange], namely the mate [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate] of the inverse-image square isomorphism constructed using $fg'=gf'$ and composition [lem-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image-composition]. Here the exact-functor cohomology comparison [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-complex-cohomology] identifies $\mathcal H^q(g^{-1}Rf_*F)$ with $g^{-1}R^qf_*F$.
For an etale $U\to Y$ [def-weil-etale-morphism], put $U'=Y'\times_YU$, $T=X\times_YU$, and $T'=X'\times_{Y'}U'$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $t:T'\to T$ be induced by $g'$ and $U'\to U$, and let $F_T$ denote the inverse image of $F$ on $T$. Write $\theta_{f,U}:H^q(T,F_T)\to(R^qf_*F)(U)$ and $\theta_{f',U'}:H^q(T',t^{-1}F_T)\to(R^qf'_*g'^{-1}F)(U')$ for the canonical maps to the sheaves associated to the cohomology presheaves [sbc-lem-higher-direct-image-presheaf], using inverse-image composition identifications. Write $\eta_{g,U}:(R^qf_*F)(U)\to(g^{-1}R^qf_*F)(U')$ for the map on sections induced by the adjunction unit of inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Then
$$
 E^q(U')\circ\eta_{g,U}\circ\theta_{f,U}
 =\theta_{f',U'}\circ t^*:
 H^q(T,F_T)\longrightarrow(R^qf'_*g'^{-1}F)(U'),
$$
where $H^q$ is etale cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] and $t^*$ is cohomology pullback [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. This equality is natural in $F$ and in morphisms of etale test objects $U$.

proof.text: Use the canonical inverse raw evaluation to represent an input cohomology class by a raw derived-Hom morphism z. Transport z by the canonical inverse-image source comparison and the single and shift comparisons. The mate/class comparison identifies exchange of its higher-image section with the higher-image section of the transported raw class.

Raw evaluation commutes with the geometric pullback on the induced chart square, including its actual coefficient composition map. Evaluate the raw transport of z, use evaluation of inverse evaluation to recover the original input, and cancel the inverse evaluation on the target. Combining this equality with the mate/class comparison proves the chart identity.

For coefficients, adjunction naturality commutes a shifted single coefficient map through the raw class adjunct. Naturality of the shift-to-degree-q homology comparison gives the coefficient formula for the higher-image class. Degree-q exchange is a composite of natural transformations, so it commutes with this map; combine with naturality of the inverse-image unit. For test objects, use naturality of the higher-image comparison presheaf and of the composite sheaf morphism consisting of that unit and degree-q exchange. The raw inverse evaluation cancels in both input expressions. This proves exactly the two stated naturality clauses.
